source: Bear-logo wording and six practice exchanges saved together
lessonTheme: Using a logo, readiness, gender agreement and yes/no questions
summary: Used Spanish during the bear-logo creation task; corrected prender to aprender in that context. Reused usarlo and usarla correctly. Recalled está listo, introduced lista for feminine nouns, and practised yes/no questions. Readiness gender became inconsistent after initially correct use. In the final negative feature sentence, no was correctly placed but listo needed lista.

observations.learnerText: Necesitamos crear un Logo Para prender. Un oso espanol
observations.correctedText: Necesitamos crear un logo para aprender español, con un oso.
observations.outcome: Productive use of necesitamos crear and bear/logo vocabulary during a real creation task. Supplied aprender for the intended learning meaning and standard spelling. This entry records language only; no image asset is published by this update.
Correctly replaced el logo with attached lo after a model using usar.
Correct sentence structure and masculine listo; supplied accent on está. Tutor then introduced feminine lista.

Correct la and lista for explicitly stated la función after a model; supplied accent. Tutor then explained yes/no questions can retain statement word order with questioning intonation and punctuation.

Question word order was appropriate. Corrected esto to está, feminine lista to masculine listo for el logo, and standard punctuation/capitalization. Reinforced the paired chunks el logo está listo / la función está lista.
Correct words and masculine agreement for the logo. Supplied accents and punctuation.

Correct no placement after the noun subject and before está. Supplied Spanish función, lowercase no, accent on está, and feminine lista. Gender agreement still needs focused review despite earlier correct modelled use.

nextSteps: Contrast el logo está listo with la función está lista in short sentences
Keep no before the conjugated verb after a named noun subject
Distinguish está from esto in the practised readiness chunk
Revisit readiness gender after a gap before assuming retention
assessmentNote: Correct structure and pronoun selection are distinguished from supplied spelling, inconsistent adjective agreement and an earlier model.
